summary: Iteration 5 covered the 3 NEW features + regression. Backend: 34/34 pytest cases pass (24 regression + 10 new across TestRoadmap and TestToneTuning). Roadmap flow verified end-to-end: POST /api/roadmap/generate returned 3 pending suggestions (TEST_Family 2->1, TEST_Movement 4->1, TEST_Sleep 3->1) each with domainId/domainName/currentTarget/suggestedTarget(1-7)/rationale/status=pending; suggestions mirror in workspace.roadmap; POST /apply updated the domain targetFrequency (TEST_Family ring changed 0/2 -> 0/1 in UI) and removed the card; POST /dismiss removed the card; unknown ids -> 404. Tone tuning: PUT /api/profile persists directiveness (verified 80 in workspace.profile), POST /companion/feedback shifts -15/+15 with floor 0 / cap 100, unknown kind -> 400; /companion still responds after tune. Frontend mobile (390x844) with fixture token: Domains tab shows WEEKLY ROADMAP + Review, generation shows 3 suggestion cards with correct current->suggested delta + rationale + Approve/Dismiss; ring target updates on approve. Reflect DOMAIN BALANCE now distinguishes all three states — 'no entries in N days' (quiet no rest), 'quiet for N days — you chose rest on 1 of them' with rest tag, and 'no entries yet' for a never-touched domain; Today AN OBSERVATION reads 'TEST_Sleep — no entries in 223 days' neutrally. Companion tune-toggle expands panel with 3 ctone-* chips + directiveness-slider (Firm/Gentle labels, 0-100) + save-tone; saving triggers tune-toast. fb-pushy / fb-soft appear on the latest AI reply and tapping shows confirmation toast 'Noted — I'll ease off next time.'. Regression: SAFETY SUPPORT label + 988 crisis text confirmed present on hopeless prompt (iter4 flagged bug is fixed). No red screens, no deprecated Expo packages, no console errors during flows.
action_items: OPTIONAL: The tune-toast text was momentarily empty during the tone-save check (auto-dismiss timing) but appeared correctly after fb-pushy. Consider extending the toast display window from 3s to ~4s to make it more reliably visible in E2E and by hand.
OPTIONAL: Roadmap 'Nothing changes until you approve' copy is clear; consider adding accessibilityLabel to the delta 'currentTarget × / wk arrow suggestedTarget × / wk' for screen readers.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/roadmap/generate correctly clamps suggestedTarget to 1..7, filters out same-target suggestions, replaces prior pending suggestions per-user before re-inserting, and excludes _id from responses.
server.py /api/roadmap/{sid}/apply and /dismiss both scope by user_id and return 404 when not found — no cross-user leakage.

server.py PUT /api/profile now persists directiveness (0-100) via ProfileInput default 50; /companion/feedback uses upsert profile with floor/cap. Directiveness is threaded into the companion system prompt via directiveness_note().
index.tsx uses safety: !!m.safety when hydrating messages from workspace and safety: result.isSafety when appending — the SAFETY SUPPORT bubble regression from iter4 is resolved. Verified live.
deviationNote in index.tsx has explicit branches for active/quiet/rest/no-entries-yet, matching product spec. Rest tag rendered as a chip with distinctive #F2DDD5 background + clay text.
Roadmap Approve button uses colors.forest, Dismiss ghost uses muted — good visual hierarchy; both meet 44px touch height (paddingVertical 11 + text ~22px).

success_rate.frontend: 6/6 flows (100%) — roadmap generate/approve/dismiss + ring update, reflect deviation memory (all 3 states + rest tag), today observation, companion tune save + fb-pushy toast + fb-soft visible, crisis fallback with SAFETY SUPPORT label & 988

Feedback tests set/reset profile.directiveness during flow (final value 50 after test cycles). Roadmap UI run approved one suggestion (TEST_Family targetFrequency 2 -> 1) and dismissed another — this is persisted seed for main-agent smoke checks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://companion-compass.preview.emergentagent.com. Fixture token: test-session-lifeos-fixture-0001. Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_lifeos_backend.py has TestRoadmap (4 tests) and TestToneTuning (6 tests). To retest roadmap deterministically, first POST /api/logs with dates in the last 14 days so recentTouches counts are non-zero; then POST /api/roadmap/generate. Domains tab uses testIDs review-roadmap / roadmap-<id> / roadmap-apply-<id> / roadmap-dismiss-<id>. Companion tab uses tune-toggle to expand, ctone-<tone-with-hyphens>, directiveness-slider, save-tone, tune-toast, fb-pushy, fb-soft. The tune-toast display window is ~3s — poll the DOM within 2s after tapping save-tone or feedback to catch the text.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration.
